newsitem.title: USA: US Army Corps closes Mississippi locks, high water.
newsitem.headline: US Army Corps closes Mississippi locks, high water.

text.p: The U.S. Army Corps of Engineers has closed three locks on the upper Mississippi near Minneapolis, Minn., due to high water and more closures are expected Monday, a corps official said.
"We expect to close Lock 4, near Alma, Wisconsin today (Monday) and that one will impact navigation," said Mari Cronberg, a Corps public affairs officer.
The upper and lower St. Anthony Falls Locks and Lock No. 1 at Minneapolis were closed Friday. Those closures should only affect recreational river traffic, Cronberg said.
The Corps will also decide Monday whether Lock No. 2 at Hastings, Minn., and Lock No. 3 between Hastings and Red Wing, Minn., will close, Cronberg said.
With forecast river stages, it appears all of the St. Paul District's 13 locks from St. Anthony's Falls to Guttenburg, Iowa, will close, the corps said in a news release.
